seed-0001.title: Two Sum
seed-0001.description:
Given an array of integers `nums` and an integer `target`, return **indices** of the two numbers such that they add up to `target`.

You may assume each input has **exactly one** solution, and you may not use the same element twice. Return the answer in any order.

This is the classic warm-up every interview loop starts with — build the hashmap intuition first.

seed-0002.title: Valid Parentheses
seed-0002.description:
Given a string `s` containing just `'('`, `')'`, `'{'`, `'}'`, `'['` and `']'`, determine if the input string is valid.

Open brackets must be closed by the same type, in the correct order, with a matching open for every close.

seed-0003.title: Maximum Subarray
seed-0003.description:
Given an integer array `nums`, find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum, and return its **sum**.

Kadane's algorithm is the expected linear-time approach.

seed-0004.title: Merge Intervals
seed-0004.description: Given `intervals` where `intervals[i] = [starti, endi]`, merge all overlapping intervals and return the covering non-overlapping set.

seed-0005.title: Binary Search
seed-0005.description: Given a sorted array `nums` and `target`, return its index or `-1`. Must run in `O(log n)`.

seed-0006.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
seed-0006.description: Given daily `prices`, buy once and sell later for maximum profit. Return `0` if no profit is possible.

seed-0007.title: Number of Islands
seed-0007.description: Given a grid of `'1'` (land) and `'0'` (water), return the number of islands formed by horizontally/vertically connected land.

seed-0008.title: Climbing Stairs
seed-0008.description: A staircase has `n` steps. You can climb 1 or 2 steps at a time. How many distinct ways to reach the top?

seed-0009.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
seed-0009.description: Find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters. Sliding window + last-seen map is the standard approach.

seed-0010.title: Product of Array Except Self
seed-0010.description: Return `answer` where `answer[i]` is the product of all `nums` elements except `nums[i]`. `O(n)` time, no division.
